title: Normalized internal and section scalar adjunction predicate
statement: For a site with the fixed abelian sheaf tensor and reconstruction [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], and an internal coefficient morphism with its section map and balanced generators [def-sfb-section-scalar-map-data], define InternalSectionScalarAdjunction to assert existence of a section scalar pair [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], an identity-on-sections restriction comparison and a generator-preserving ordinary extension comparison preserving transposes. Include an internal universal left-derived pair, its K-flat computation, its adjunction with exact restriction, and the equality of its derived unit with localization of the ordinary unit [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Derived restriction is exactly localization of ordinary restriction; the derived extension comparison is fixed on flat-term K-flat representatives by the localized ordinary comparison, and the specified derived transposes agree. This defines the existing full normalization predicate, without asserting it holds.
